<section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-323aab1 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="323aab1" data-element_type="section" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
<div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-d84025a" data-id="d84025a" data-element_type="column" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-dc04e9b elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="dc04e9b" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Itinerary </h2>				</div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-440fb03 elementor-widget elementor-widget-accordion" data-id="440fb03" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="accordion.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<div class="elementor-accordion">
<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
<div id="elementor-tab-title-7131" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="1" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-7131" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-left" aria-hidden="true">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
</span>
<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">Mayapo</a>
</div>
<div id="elementor-tab-content-7131" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="1" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-7131"><p>Meet the group just 40′ from Riohacha airport and jump into your first session. This open-ocean spot averages 25 knots. The water’s a bit choppy, but the next ones are glass-flat!</p></div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
<div id="elementor-tab-title-7132" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="2" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-7132" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-left" aria-hidden="true">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
</span>
<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">Cabo de la vela</a>
</div>
<div id="elementor-tab-content-7132" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="2" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-7132"><p>Spend 5 days on perfect flat water with steady 25–30 knot winds. Nestled in the desert and home to the Wayuu community, Cabo offers fresh fish, starry nights, and calm mornings to recharge your body and mind.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
<div id="elementor-tab-title-7133" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="3" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-7133" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-left" aria-hidden="true">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
</span>
<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">Punta Gallinas</a>
</div>
<div id="elementor-tab-content-7133" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="3" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-7133"><p>Spend 2 days at the northernmost point of South America! Ride butter-flat turquoise waters, clean waves, and steady 25–30 knot winds surrounded by stunning desert landscapes. Top it off with a 20 km downwinder through mangroves to the sea.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
<div id="elementor-tab-title-7134" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="4" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-7134" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-left" aria-hidden="true">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
</span>
<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">Palomino</a>
</div>
<div id="elementor-tab-content-7134" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="4" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-7134"><p>After adventurous days in the desert, unwind in a charming beach village. We’ll end the trip with delicious meals and a tranquil jungle stay, complete with a beautiful river float.</p></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-100 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-6ac283d" data-id="6ac283d" data-element_type="column">

<section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-3dbd97b9 elementor-hidden-tablet elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="3dbd97b9" data-element_type="section" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
<div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-100 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-61b7bed5" data-id="61b7bed5" data-element_type="column">
<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4c35e44 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="4c35e44" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">FAQ</h2>				</div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-728d9f4 elementor-widget elementor-widget-accordion" data-id="728d9f4" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="accordion.default">
<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<div class="elementor-accordion">
<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
<div id="elementor-tab-title-1201" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="1" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1201" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-left" aria-hidden="true">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
</span>
<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">Do I need travel adapter for my electronics?</a>
</div>
<div id="elementor-tab-content-1201" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="1" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1201"><p>In Colombia, the power sockets used are of type A and type B. Here are the details:</p><ol><li><strong>Type A</strong>: This socket has two flat parallel pins.</li><li><strong>Type B</strong>: This socket has two flat parallel pins and a grounding pin.</li></ol><p>The standard voltage in Colombia is 110 V, and the frequency is 60 Hz. If your devices use a different voltage, you may need a voltage converter in addition to a plug adapter.</p><p>Here&#8217;s a summary:</p><ul><li><strong>Socket Types</strong>: A and B</li><li><strong>Standard Voltage</strong>: 110 V</li><li><strong>Frequency</strong>: 60 Hz</li></ul><p>Ensure that your devices are compatible with this voltage to avoid damage. If your device&#8217;s plug is not compatible with type A or B sockets, you will need a plug adapter.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
<div id="elementor-tab-title-1202" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="2" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1202" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-left" aria-hidden="true">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
</span>
<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">Do I need a visa to enter Colombia?</a>
</div>
<div id="elementor-tab-content-1202" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="2" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1202"><p><strong>Tourist Visa</strong>: Citizens from many countries, including the United States, Canada, most European Union countries, Australia, and New Zealand, do not need a visa for tourist stays of up to 90 days. This period can often be extended once you are in Colombia.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
<div id="elementor-tab-title-1203" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="3" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1203" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-left" aria-hidden="true">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
</span>
<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">**Cancellation Policy:**</a>
</div>
<div id="elementor-tab-content-1203" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="3" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1203"><p class="cvGsUA direction-ltr align-justify para-style-body"><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none">Payment Information:</span></p><ul><li><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none">A 30% deposit is required to secure your spot in the kite camp.</span></li><li><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none">The remaining balance must be paid at least 30 days before the camp starts. Payment can be made in two installments.</span></li></ul><p class="cvGsUA direction-ltr align-justify para-style-body"><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none">Cancellation &amp; Refund Policy:</span></p><ul><li><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none">Cancellation 90 days before the starting date of the camp: The deposit will be refunded.</span></li><li><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none">Cancellation less than 90 days before the starting date of the camp: The deposit will not be refunded. Exception: If cancellation is made for a medical reason, guests must provide medical proof of inability. Your deposit can then be used towards a future camp and must be used within 12 months from the cancellation date.</span></li><li><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none">For cancellations made by Global Kite Trips, the deposit will be fully refunded.</span></li></ul></div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
<div id="elementor-tab-title-1204" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="4" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1204" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-left" aria-hidden="true">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
</span>
<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">Is the Wi-Fi great where we are going?</a>
</div>
<div id="elementor-tab-content-1204" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="4" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1204"><p>Feel free to bring your laptop and do a few hours of work every day if you need to. 🌐💼 There will be fast internet at this destination, and in case you want to be doubly safe, we can always get you a sim card. 📶</p></div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
<div id="elementor-tab-title-1205" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="5" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1205" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-left" aria-hidden="true">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
</span>
<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">Am I too old or too young for this trip?</a>
</div>
<div id="elementor-tab-content-1205" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="5" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1205"><p>A lot of our first-time guests are concerned about this!</p><p>To give you an idea, about 80% of our guests are between 25 and 55 years old, with the most significant concentration being in their 30&#8217;s and 40&#8217;s. This is, on average, each trip is a bit different.</p><p>We are firm believers that age is just a number! If you are under 25 or over 55, you are certainly welcome in our retreats. What is important to our organization is to be transparent in the type of experience we deliver. Our guests come to focus on their surfing progression and to have a great time. Some of them enjoy a beer or a cocktail at sunset, but if you are looking for a place to party all week, this is not the right experience for you.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
<div id="elementor-tab-title-1206" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="6" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1206" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-left" aria-hidden="true">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
</span>
<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">Is it safe to travel to the destination?</a>
</div>
<div id="elementor-tab-content-1206" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="6" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1206"><p>In each of our destinations, you will be led by experienced guides with in-depth knowledge of the area and the spot. 🌍 We also carefully choose secure accommodations to ensure the safety of our travelers.</p><p>That being said, we encourage our travelers to embrace the freedom of exploring and experimenting with each destination as they wish, as we believe in the beauty of traveling. ✈️ 💫 We provide necessary security advice for each trip, and when followed, the risks of any trouble, such as robbery or accidents, are very low.  Your safety is our top priority!</p></div>
</div>
<div class="elementor-accordion-item">
<div id="elementor-tab-title-1207" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="7" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1207" aria-expanded="false">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon elementor-accordion-icon-left" aria-hidden="true">
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></span>
<span class="elementor-accordion-icon-opened"><i class="fas fa-minus"></i></span>
</span>
<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0"> I am planning to travel alone on this trip. Will there be any other lone travelers on my trip? </a>
</div>
<div id="elementor-tab-content-1207" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="7" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1207"><p>About half of our travelers are &#8220;lone travelers&#8221;, so you will most probably not be the only lone traveler in your group. 🌐👫 Whether you are traveling with other groups of friends, couples, or fellow lone travelers, you can expect to meet new friends with whom you will have a great time! 🤝✨ Embrace the opportunity to connect and share incredible experiences with like-minded adventurers. 🌍🏞️</p></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</section>

entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
